primary.paraphrase: Equations (4)–(6) average per-leaf observation weights into a conditional empirical CDF; Section 3 obtains quantiles by the inverse-CDF rule in equation (1). Retaining response values distinguishes QRF from quantiles of tree means. Section 4 imposes distribution, leaf-size and splitting assumptions for consistency, following the independent-observation setup of Section 2. These definitions support a finite fixed-specification QRF baseline, not optimal tuning, a reproduction of the original empirical experiments, or automatic validity for overlapping time-series labels and possible floor atoms.
